description: Generate realistic, reproducible fake test data from a field schema: up to 1,000 records with 44 field types (names, usernames, emails consistent with the name, phones, companies, job titles, US addresses, countries, coordinates, dates, numbers, prices, UUIDs, IPs, URLs, lorem text, enums with weights, sequences, templates referencing other fields, test card numbers), per-field null rate and uniqueness, as JSON, CSV or NDJSON. Seeded (the seed is returned) so the same request gives the same data. Safe by design: only example.* domains, 555-01xx phone numbers, documentation IP ranges and public card test numbers. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/fake-data

fields.description: Field name => type name, or {type, ...options} (min / max / decimals / from / to / values / weights / start / step / template / value / nullRate / unique)

seed.description: Reproducible output (a random seed is chosen and returned when omitted)

name: fake_data
